name: AK3 - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, Temperature, Humidity), Portable
highlights: Five Readings, One Glance — CO₂, TVOC and formaldehyde alongside temperature and humidity, each on its own colour status band — five readings that most households otherwise buy as three or four separate meters, one at a time.
The Entry Point to the Range — Semiconductor sensing across all three gas channels keeps the cost down while still showing you the trend that matters — when a room needs airing.
Small Enough to Leave Out — At 212 g and 32 mm deep it sits on a nightstand or desk without dominating it, and travels in a bag when a client wants a site reading.
1200 mAh, 6–8 Hours Cordless — About three hours to a full charge over USB. A lanyard is included for walk-around checks.

Two Price Tiers, One Carton Spec — AK3 and the NDIR version AK4 share the same body, colour box and 50-per-carton pack. A distributor carries both tiers on one pallet, with a single freight calculation.
